title: Money fields are left out of field usage for users without financial data
custom_preconds:
1. Sign in to the build under test as a dispatcher whose role has Work Orders view and Work Orders create and edit (check: Settings > Roles & Permissions > open the role > on the Work Orders card, View and Create & Edit are both ticked. The Admin role has both).
  2. In the top bar, choose the location you test in (e.g. "Heavy Duty"). Every technician and work order below belongs to this location.
  3. Use a desktop browser window at least 1024 px wide (the display switcher only shows at 1024 px and wider).
  4. You can open Google Analytics for the property the QA build reports to, at Admin > DebugView. The QA build runs analytics in debug mode, so each event appears in DebugView within a few seconds under your user. If you cannot open DebugView, the event checks in this case cannot be done by hand: write "not checked by hand" in the result comment and pass or fail on what you can see on the Work Orders page.
  5. Event names to look for in DebugView: work_orders_display_view (a display was shown), work_orders_field_load and work_orders_density_load (the fields and density you have, once per display per session), work_orders_field_toggle and work_orders_density_change (a saved change).
  6. A user without the see financial data permission: Settings > Roles & Permissions > create a custom role (e.g. "ZZAUTOTEST No Money") with Work Orders View and Create & Edit but not see financial data. Add a staff member with that role and sign them in.
  7. Start a fresh analytics session: close every browser window, open a new private window and sign in.
custom_steps:
1. As the user without see financial data, open Work Orders and click Board View.
  2. In DebugView, count the work_orders_field_load events and look for total_price.
  3. Click Tech View in the display switcher at the right of the toolbar (the design tooltip reads "By Lead Tech").
  4. Count the new work_orders_field_load events and look for total_price.
  5. Open Fields to display in Board View and look for Total price.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 2: 12 field events (13 − 1). No event for total price.
  • Step 4: 14 field events (15 − 1). No event for total price.
  • Step 5: Total price is not offered in the picker, and no card shows a dollar amount.
  • Total for this user: 12 + 14 = 26. Total price is left out of usage completely for this user, so it cannot lower that field's usage rate.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043; story SV-10593 (Story 12, Google Analytics for display and field usage); SV-10048 (Story 5, Fields to display and columns); PRD Confluence 845185030, edited 7 Oct 2026 (status line "PRD v33"), S12-R7, S5-E2, read 8 Oct 2026. Event names and timing: SV-10593 comments by Slavcho Mitrov and Milos Vasic, 6 Oct 2026 (the agreed GA4 event table); earlier event contract on Review Decisions page 853901313 (29 Sep 2026) uses older names.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S12-R7: “Exclude unavailable financial fields from field-exposure measurement and its denominator.”
  • S5-E2: “Without see financial data permission, hide all dollar-amount fields from displays, filters, and field/column pickers.”
